create_LLAMA3p2_embeddings: create a LLAMA3p2 model instance to compute word embeddings using Llama-3.2-3B hidden states
call_LLAMA3p2_extract_features: call the LLAMA3p2 model with events, start time, and duration to extract text feature tensors
prepare_LLAMA3p2_from_dataframe: prepare a LLAMA3p2 model from a pandas DataFrame or sequence of Word events for feature extraction
aggregate_layers_LLAMA3p2: aggregate transformer layer hidden states using group_mean or single layer selection in LLAMA3p2
create_TextDataset_for_words: create a TextDataset PyTorch Dataset from a list of Word events for batched embedding computation
